ask: My site is example.com. This week I want to post about our new roast.

arguments.name: Acme
dos: Open with the customer's problem, not our product.
donts: Never use exclamation marks in the first line.

steps.why: One save, no check. Bolta reads their own site once, only when no business record exists. DOs and DON'Ts only from their posts or words; with nothing to draw on, leave them out.
Show the voice from what was stored, and say what Bolta filled in.

say: Here is your voice for Acme: direct, warm, plain. Bolta filled in who you write for from your site. Now this week's posts about the new roast.
never: Reading the site again when a business record exists: a re-read overwrites it.
